frequency_question: How often does a proposed indirect tax adjustment on a specific financial service sector get formally approved within 24 months of initial substantive discussion?
membership_rule: Includes all major national tax council proposals affecting financial/banking intermediary services evaluated between 2010 and 2024. Excludes general annual budget rate standardizations.
coverage_note: 6 named representative cases; believed roughly 9 in total across comparable modern tax council jurisdictions
known_gaps: Varying degrees of economic urgency across different sub-sectors of financial services.
skeleton: 6 historical regulatory review cycles across comparable fiscal policy domains, adjusted for institutional approval tendencies.
multiplier: 4 hits out of 6 enumerated comparable cases
validity_reason: Tax council institutional procedures and decision-making cadences remain stable over medium-term horizons.
